user.title: Connect Ellevio
user.description: Use your Mina sidor login and customer ID. Installations are discovered from your account in the next step.

installations.title: Choose installations
installations.description: Select the installations (anläggningar) to import. Rename them later under Configure.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Ellevio
reauth_confirm.description: Your Ellevio login expired or was rejected. Enter your credentials again.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Ellevio
reconfigure.description: Update your Mina sidor login. The next step lists the installations on your account so you can add or remove them.

reconfigure_installations.title: Installations
reconfigure_installations.description: Select the installations to import. Unselected installations are removed along with their devices.

error.no_installations_found: No consumption installations found on this account.

data.supplier_price_per_kwh: Supplier energy price, SEK/kWh (0 = grid fees only)

rename.title: Rename an installation
rename.description: Pick an installation and enter a new name. Leave the name empty to reset it to the default. The new name applies to the statistics and device after the next import.
